Kforce has a client in Maryland Heights, MO seeking a Full Stack Developer (Python/React) to help produce and expand a custom enterprise application that enables users to gather, transform, and manage data through a modern ETL platform.

Summary:
This is a backend-focused development role with an emphasis on building production-grade Python applications and APIs in AWS. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience taking applications from development through production, integrating frontend and backend components, implementing CI/CD practices, and building cloud infrastructure using Terraform. While this is primarily a backend role, candidates should have enough frontend knowledge to work effectively within a full-stack environment, troubleshoot across the application, and support React-based components when necessary.

Responsibilities:
 
  Design, develop, and support backend application functionality using Python and FastAPI 
  Build and maintain APIs that enable communication between frontend and backend application components 
  Integrate application APIs with internal LLM services and understand how to consume LLM capabilities within an application 
  Help transition an existing proof of concept into a scalable, production-ready application 
  Develop and deploy applications within an AWS environment 
  Build and maintain cloud infrastructure using Terraform 
  Work with PostgreSQL for backend data storage and application functionality 
  Support containerized application deployments using Kubernetes 
  Implement and follow established CI/CD and SDLC best practices 
  Collaborate across frontend, backend, infrastructure, and testing functions to ensure successful application delivery 
 
 
  Strong Python software development experience with significant backend application development 
  Hands-on Python API development experience 
  Experience developing APIs using FastAPI 
  Demonstrated experience building and productionizing applications in AWS, including taking an application through development, deployment, and production 
  Experience integrating frontend and backend applications/APIs 
  Hands-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code 
  AWS cloud development experience, including exposure to services and concepts such as VPCs and AWS Secrets Manager 
  Experience with Kubernetes and containerized application environments 
  Experience with PostgreSQL 
  Experience implementing or working within CI/CD pipelines 
  Experience with Git-based source control 
  Experience working within Agile/Scrum sprint environments 
  Experience consuming or integrating with LLMs through APIs, or the ability to work with internal LLM services as part of an application 
  Proven experience supporting real-world, production applications rather than primarily prototype or proof-of-concept development 
  Working knowledge of frontend development, preferably ReactJS, with the ability to understand and troubleshoot frontend components 
  Solid understanding of SDLC, testing, code quality, and production software engineering best practices 

 
Nice to Have:
 
  Stronger hands-on experience with ReactJS and full-stack application development 
  Experience with AWS Lambda 
  Experience with Helm and YAML 
  Experience developing ETL, data transformation, or data-processing applications 
  Experience using AI-assisted software development tools as part of the development lifecycle 
  Experience contributing to application testing and QA activities in addition to core software development
